Serialized pivot URNs for the record (one entry per requested pivot).
ACCOUNT pivot -- Group results by ad account.
CAMPAIGN pivot -- Group results by campaign.
CAMPAIGN_GROUP pivot -- Group results by campaign group.
CARD_INDEX pivot -- Group results by carousel card index.
COMPANY pivot -- Group results by advertiser's company.
CONVERSATION_NODE pivot -- Information for each node of the conversation tree.
CONVERSATION_NODE_OPTION_INDEX pivot -- Conversation node button index.
CONVERSION pivot -- Group results by conversion.
CREATIVE pivot -- Group results by creative.
EVENT_STAGE pivot -- Group results by live event stage (PRE_LIVE/LIVE/POST_LIVE).
IMPRESSION_DEVICE_TYPE pivot -- Group results by impression device type.
MEMBER_COMPANY pivot -- Group results by member company.
MEMBER_COMPANY_SIZE pivot -- Group results by member company size.
MEMBER_COUNTRY_V2 pivot -- Group results by member country (Bing geo).
MEMBER_COUNTY pivot -- Group results by member county (Bing geo).
MEMBER_INDUSTRY pivot -- Group results by member industry.
MEMBER_JOB_FUNCTION pivot -- Group results by member job function.
MEMBER_JOB_TITLE pivot -- Group results by member job title.
MEMBER_REGION_V2 pivot -- Group results by member region (Bing geo).
MEMBER_SENIORITY pivot -- Group results by member seniority.
OBJECTIVE_TYPE pivot -- Group results by campaign objective type (statistics finder).
PLACEMENT_NAME pivot -- Group results by placement.
SERVING_LOCATION pivot -- Group results by serving location (onsite/offsite).
SHARE pivot -- Group results by sponsored share.
